schemaNote: C11 provider promotion policy. Tiers: A local-open-free (default, green) > B subscription-covers-IDE (blue) > C metered (red, never promoted; loud cost modal + typed 'ENABLE METERED' confirm + CostGuardrail). The engine localai re-point flow is the escape hatch to demote any provider to a local endpoint.

tierLegend.A: local / open / free — default, promoted, green cost light
tierLegend.B: covered by an existing IDE/subscription — blue cost light, no per-token charge to the user
tierLegend.C: metered pay-per-token — red cost light, NEVER auto-promoted, requires typed 'ENABLE METERED' confirm

providers.label: Local (Ollama / llama.cpp / engine localai)
providers.notes: Default. Runs open-weight models locally; no network, no cost. modelhub.fit.score guides model/quant choice.

providers.label: Generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint
providers.notes: Self-hosted or LAN gateway speaking the OpenAI API. Treated Tier-A when pointed at a local/free host; cost is whatever the host charges (out of band).

providers.label: Open-weight API host (Together / Groq / Fireworks / OpenRouter free tiers)
providers.notes: Hosts the same open weights but bills per token. Metered → Tier C unless the user pins a free tier.

providers.label: Claude (Anthropic)
providers.notes: Anthropic mandates API (pay-per-token) billing for third-party IDE/tool use — Tier C only. The Claude Code / claude.ai subscription does NOT extend to a third-party IDE like Prometheus Studio, so there is NO Tier-B promotion here (unlike ChatGPT/Copilot/Cursor). Studio surfaces the localai re-point-to-local escape hatch. (verifyAtSetup — confirm current ToS.)

providers.label: ChatGPT (OpenAI)
providers.notes: Metered API by default (Tier C). A covered IDE/subscription seat promotes to Tier B.

providers.label: Gemini (Google)
providers.includedInSubscriptionVia: Gemini Code Assist / Google One AI seat
providers.notes: Metered API by default (Tier C). A covered Code Assist seat promotes to Tier B.

providers.label: GitHub Copilot
providers.notes: Flat-rate subscription that covers IDE use — Tier B (blue). No per-token charge surfaced to the user.

providers.label: Cursor
providers.notes: Subscription covers IDE use — Tier B (blue). Metered overage (if any) is out of band and not auto-promoted.

pricingNote: USD per 1M tokens; longest-prefix match, case-insensitive (CLI-058). Local models are $0 via endpoint locality, NOT this table. Approximate 2026 list prices — verify against the provider before relying on a figure.
